title: Goku Drip
blurb: The Goku Drip sound — the beat that plays whenever someone's outfit goes impossibly hard, canonized by the legendary image of Goku in Supreme. 'Drip' culture and anime collided and this audio was the result. Use it for fit checks, glow-ups, and anyone stepping out with unearned confidence. The drip is non-negotiable; the sound makes it official.
origin: From the viral 'Drip Goku' meme — Goku in streetwear, awarded maximum drip.
